title: Operations: structured logging, tracing, run context, metrics, data retention and capacity
findings: Logging, tracing and metrics settings are dead configuration: logs are plain text, the reference shown to users is never logged, spans go nowhere, and there are no metrics
Hot orchestrator queries lack indexes, the resume sweep rescans every approval ever approved each minute, and no history is ever purged
No way to delete uploaded documents or agent memory, retention jobs never run, and the secret redactor is dead code
Connection pools and run concurrency are unbounded relative to the database: HPA scale-out can need 750 connections against a 200-300 limit, with no per-workspace run cap
Every restart, rolling deploy or HPA scale-down kills in-flight runs; nothing drains them and the code's 'resume after restart' promise is false
spec:
Standard rules apply. There is no migration. Do not edit AgentRunner, which WP23 owns this wave. Set MDC around the AgentRunner calls instead.

1) Logging
- In platform-defaults.yml, set logging.structured.format.console to ${AIWOS_LOG_FORMAT_CONSOLE:}. Use the value ecs in k8s and compose; leave it empty locally, which keeps plain text.
- Set logging.pattern.correlation to show requestId, runId and orgId in text mode.
- In PlatformProperties, delete the dead Observability fields: logFormat, tracingEnabled, otlpEndpoint, metricsEnabled and logLevel.
- Bind traceSampleRatio to management.tracing.sampling.probability. Fix the validator so a production ratio of 0.1 starts, and add a test for it.
- Remove the unused logstash-logback-encoder dependency.
- In GlobalExceptionHandler, add requestId to the 5xx log line.

2) Tracing
- Set management.tracing.enabled to ${AIWOS_TRACING_ENABLED:true}.
- Set MANAGEMENT_OTLP_TRACING_ENDPOINT only in k8s and compose. Either add an otel-collector service to infra/compose or remove the env line there.
- ActorContextFilter sets RequestContext.traceId from the current span.
- The gateway calls Hooks.enableAutomaticContextPropagation().

3) Run context
- RunExecutor wraps its executor with ContextExecutorService (io.micrometer.context) so that MDC and trace context propagate.
- Put runId, goalId, orgId and agentId into MDC around runner calls in RunExecutor, GoalService.runNextTask and the MaintenanceScheduler sweeps. Clear them in finally.

4) Metrics (low-cardinality tags only)
- aiwos.runs.finished: counter with tag status, in TaskProgress.
- aiwos.run.duration: timer.
- aiwos.runs.abandoned: counter.
- aiwos.approvals.pending: gauge, refreshed every 60 s.
- aiwos.llm.call: latency and cost, tagged by provider and outcome, in ModelRouter.
- aiwos.sweep.duration: timer.

5) Dashboards and alerts
- Add a Grafana dashboard JSON and a dashboard provider under infra/grafana/provisioning.
- Add Prometheus rule_files with three alerts:
  - abandoned runs above 0 in 15 minutes;
  - provider failure rate above 20%;
  - a readiness probe down.

6) Per-provider concurrency
- In ModelRouter, add a Resilience4j Bulkhead sized from ProviderDescriptor.maxConcurrentRequests and a requestsPerMinute limiter, built with ResiliencePresets.

7) Retention
- Add a runtime setting retention.runDetailDays per workspace, default 180.
- Add a nightly MaintenanceScheduler job guarded by pg_try_advisory_lock. In batches of 1,000, for runs that finished before the cutoff, null the heavy run_steps.detail fields (modelContent and arguments). Keep the step rows, summaries and cost.
- Keep llm_usage for 400 days.
- Purge chat messages that belong to deleted conversations.
- In identity, add a SessionSweep (@EnableScheduling) that calls Sessions.deleteExpiredBefore.
- In memory-service, schedule EpisodicMemory.purgeExpired.
- Add a retention field to Settings.tsx.
- Add a statement to Trust.tsx: 'Agent traces are kept for 180 days by default; administrators can change this.'

8) Capacity documentation
- Set DB_POOL_SIZE per Deployment in the infra/k8s base so that the sum of maxReplicas times pool size, plus a reserve, stays at or below max_connections.
- Document this rule in comments next to the values.

Tests
- Validator with ratio 0.1.
- MDC is present in run log lines (test appender).
- The retention job clears only old detail fields.
- The meters are registered.

Acceptance
- With AIWOS_LOG_FORMAT_CONSOLE=ecs, the logs are JSON and include requestId.
- The request id shown on a 5xx error can be found in the logs.
- The Grafana dashboard loads under compose.
